Plot a heatmap from a Seurat object

TS_plot_heatmap_from_seuratobject.Rd

Creates a ComplexHeatmap heatmap from a Seurat object using either cell-level expression values or averaged expression per group. Columns can be grouped by Seurat::Idents() or by any metadata column, and cell-level heatmaps can optionally be ordered by pseudotime. Only requested features are scaled; a stored scale.data layer is not required.

Usage

TS_plot_heatmap_from_seuratobject(
  seurat_object,
  features,
  plot_average_expression = FALSE,
  assay = "RNA",
  layer = "data",
  scale_rows = TRUE,
  group_by = "ident",
  group_levels = NULL,
  pseudotime_var = "pseudotime",
  show_genes = TRUE,
  show_row_dend = FALSE,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  row_names_fontsize = NULL,
  colors = NULL,
  breaks = NULL,
  color_steps = 11,
  title = NULL,
  border_col = "black",
  split_rows_by = NULL,
  group_bar_fill_colors = NULL,
  rasterise = TRUE,
  raster_by_magick = TRUE,
  legend_name = NULL,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  row_clustering_distance = "euclidean",
  row_clustering_method = "complete",
  raster_quality = 2,
  row_names_side = "left",
  row_dend_side = "left",
  row_dend_width = 15,
  highlight_genes = NULL,
  order_pseudotime = FALSE
)

Arguments

seurat_object

A Seurat object containing the expression data to plot.

features

Character vector of genes/features to include in the heatmap. Duplicated features are removed, and features not present in the object are ignored with a warning.

plot_average_expression

Logical. If TRUE, plots average expression per group. If FALSE, plots cell-level expression.

assay

Character string. Assay to use. Defaults to "RNA".

layer

Character string. Must be "data" (the default), containing log-normalized expression values.

scale_rows

Logical. Whether to z-score scale each feature across columns before plotting. Defaults to TRUE. Cell-level values are scaled across cells. For average-expression plots, values are first averaged in linear space within each group, transformed with log1p(), and then scaled across groups, giving each group equal weight. Scaling uses Seurat::ScaleData() with its default upper cap of 10. Constant features (including a single-group average) become zero. Set to FALSE to plot log-normalized values without scaling.

group_by

Character string. Grouping variable for columns. Use "ident" to group by Seurat::Idents(), or provide a metadata column name.

group_levels

Optional character vector specifying the order of groups in the heatmap. If NULL, the existing factor levels are used when available.

pseudotime_var

Character string. Metadata column used when order_pseudotime = TRUE. Defaults to "pseudotime".

show_genes

Logical. Whether gene names should be shown when row labels are enabled.

show_row_dend

Logical. Whether to show the row dendrogram.

show_row_names

Logical. Whether to show row names. If split_rows_by is supplied, row names are instead drawn in the row annotation.

row_names_fontsize

Numeric. Font size for row labels.

colors

Optional color specification for the heatmap scale. Can be either a character vector of colors or a palette function such as scales::brewer_pal(palette = "RdBu"). If NULL, defaults are chosen based on whether the plotted matrix is scaled or unscaled.

breaks

Optional numeric vector of breakpoints for the heatmap color scale. If NULL, sensible defaults are chosen from the plotted matrix. If the number of supplied colors differs from the number of breaks, the colors are distributed evenly across the range of breaks.

color_steps

Integer. Number of colors to generate when colors is a palette function. Defaults to 11.

title

Optional overall heatmap title. Defaults to NULL, meaning no title is drawn.

border_col

Border color for the heatmap body. Defaults to "black".

split_rows_by

Optional vector used to split rows into groups. Must have the same length as features before missing features are removed.

group_bar_fill_colors

Optional vector of colors for the column group annotation. Can be unnamed, or a named vector matching the group labels.

rasterise

Logical. Whether to rasterize the heatmap body.

raster_by_magick

Logical. Passed to ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap().

legend_name

Optional legend title. If NULL, a default is chosen based on plot mode.

cluster_rows

Logical. Whether to cluster rows hierarchically.

row_clustering_distance

Character string specifying the row distance metric. Defaults to "euclidean". Also supports "pearson" and "spearman".

row_clustering_method

Character string specifying the agglomeration method passed to fastcluster::hclust(). Defaults to "complete".

raster_quality

Numeric. Raster quality passed to ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap().

row_names_side

Character string. Side for row names. Defaults to "left".

row_dend_side

Character string. Side for the row dendrogram. Defaults to "left".

row_dend_width

Numeric. Width of the row dendrogram in mm.

highlight_genes

Optional character vector of genes to highlight with labels.

order_pseudotime

Logical. If TRUE, plots cell-level expression with columns ordered by pseudotime_var.

Value

A ComplexHeatmap heatmap object. If title is supplied, the returned object is the result of ComplexHeatmap::draw().

Examples

# Average expression grouped by Seurat identities
# TS_plot_heatmap_from_seuratobject(
#   seurat_object = seurat_obj,
#   features = c("CD79A", "MS4A1", "CD74"),
#   plot_average_expression = TRUE
# )

# Cell-level heatmap grouped by a metadata column with custom order
# TS_plot_heatmap_from_seuratobject(
#   seurat_object = seurat_obj,
#   features = c("MKI67", "TOP2A", "PCNA"),
#   group_by = "Phase",
#   group_levels = c("G1", "S", "G2M")
# )

# Order cells by pseudotime
# TS_plot_heatmap_from_seuratobject(
#   seurat_object = seurat_obj,
#   features = c("LEF1", "RAG1", "RAG2"),
#   order_pseudotime = TRUE
# )

# Use a richer Brewer-style diverging palette
# TS_plot_heatmap_from_seuratobject(
#   seurat_object = seurat_obj,
#   features = c("LEF1", "RAG1", "RAG2"),
#   colors = scales::brewer_pal(palette = "RdBu")(11),
#   breaks = c(-1, 0, 1)
# )
